entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sordish law dictated that if a Vice..."
entries.dialogueText: Sordish law dictated that if a Vice President failed to complete his term, new candidates were to be put forward by the members of the cabinet.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was up to me to decide who would..."
entries.dialogueText: It was up to me to decide who would fill Petr's shoes. I wanted to chat with them one on one before making my decision.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After much deliberation, the list h..."
entries.dialogueText: After much deliberation, the list had been narrowed down to three. Lucian Galade was the front-runner, followed by Gloria Tory and Albin Clavin.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had just begun to settle at my de..."
entries.dialogueText: I had just begun to settle at my desk when I heard a knock at the door. Lucian entered and perched on the chair across from me.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sir.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You know why you are here.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You know why you are here.”
entries.menuText: “You know why you are here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So. Vice President Galade. What do..."
entries.dialogueText: “So. Vice President Galade. What do you think?”
entries.menuText: “So. Vice President Galade. What do you think?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All right, Lucian. You're one hell..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right, Lucian. You're one hell of a strategist, but why should I make you VP?"
entries.menuText: "All right, Lucian. You're one hell of a strategist, but why should I make you VP?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You already know what I think, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "You already know what I think, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I do.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I do.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“In my current capacity as chief st..."
entries.dialogueText: “In my current capacity as chief strategist, I have evaluated the experience and capabilities of your potential vice presidents. Objectively, I am by far the most qualified candidate."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I would advise you not only to thi..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would advise you not only to think about our long history together, but also the many crises I have helped shepherd you through."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I won't say much beyond that. I be..."
entries.dialogueText: “I won't say much beyond that. I believe my work speaks for itself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You're such a valuable strategist...."
entries.dialogueText: “You're such a valuable strategist. I don't know if I can afford to lose you in that capacity.”
entries.menuText: “You're such a valuable strategist. I don't know if I can afford to lose you in that capacity.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't know. The public might gos..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't know. The public might gossip about your lack of a wife."
entries.menuText: “I don't know. The public might gossip about your lack of a wife."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You wanted Petr's job from day one..."
entries.dialogueText: “You wanted Petr's job from day one. How do I know you won't try to have me ousted next?"
entries.menuText: “You wanted Petr's job from day one. How do I know you won't try to have me ousted next?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Considering where Petr Vectern's p..."
entries.dialogueText: “Considering where Petr Vectern's proclivities got us, a vice president who's wholly uninterested in matters of the flesh would be a refreshing change."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“As Vice President, my ability to s..."
entries.dialogueText: “As Vice President, my ability to serve you and this administration will only increase.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Mr. Vectern proved himself unfit f..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Vectern proved himself unfit for the position with his selfish and unprofessional behavior. I am counting on you not to do the same."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian got up from his chair."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian got up from his chair.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He left my office. Just a minute la..."
entries.dialogueText: He left my office. Just a minute later, there was another knock at the door and Gloria Tory came in.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“I must say I was not surprised at..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must say I was not surprised at all when my name was put forward.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why were you not surprised?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Why were you not surprised?”
entries.menuText: “Why were you not surprised?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You seem confident.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You seem confident.”
entries.menuText: “You seem confident.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So, Gloria, tell me why I should p..."
entries.dialogueText: “So, Gloria, tell me why I should pick you.”
entries.menuText: “So, Gloria, tell me why I should pick you.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“I am, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“One does learn to expect a few thi..."
entries.dialogueText: “One does learn to expect a few things after spending so many years in government.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“To put it simply, what I bring to..."
entries.dialogueText: “To put it simply, what I bring to the table is years of experience.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“I have been a member of the Assemb..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have been a member of the Assembly for almost 20 years and I spent 7 years as its Speaker. This alone speaks for itself.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“And as you know, I am also the spo..."
entries.dialogueText: “And as you know, I am also the spokesperson of the party, as well as the leader of the conservative wing. You can see what I am getting at.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Tell me. What are you getting at?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Tell me. What are you getting at?”
entries.menuText: “Tell me. What are you getting at?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Your experience would be a great a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your experience would be a great asset.”
entries.menuText: “Your experience would be a great asset.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You become the Vice President, and..."
entries.dialogueText: “You become the Vice President, and I get the votes from the conservatives.”
entries.menuText: “You become the Vice President, and I get the votes from the conservatives.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“Precisely.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Precisely.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“Experience is always important.""
entries.dialogueText: “Experience is always important."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“Well...”"
entries.dialogueText: “Well...”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“And so is being able to rally the..."
entries.dialogueText: “And so is being able to rally the Assembly's conservative voters to your side."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“I will be blunt. Being the leader..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will be blunt. Being the leader of the conservative wing means that if I am the Vice President, we would have more votes.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“This would allow us to pass bills..."
entries.dialogueText: “This would allow us to pass bills far more easily. Especially if those bills are aligned to my bloc's causes.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“There is no us, Gloria.”"
entries.dialogueText: “There is no us, Gloria.”
entries.menuText: “There is no us, Gloria.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will think about it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will think about it.”
entries.menuText: “I will think about it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are already aligned.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We are already aligned.”
entries.menuText: “We are already aligned.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“Before outright refusing, I insist..."
entries.dialogueText: “Before outright refusing, I insist you at least think about it. Unifying the party instead of fracturing it would certainly be better for the future of the USP."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“Then that makes things easier, doe..."
entries.dialogueText: “Then that makes things easier, doesn't it?"

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“I want you to know that I value or..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want you to know that I value order over everything else, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“Being the Speaker of the Assembly..."
entries.dialogueText: “Being the Speaker of the Assembly requires principles, nerves like steel and determination to uphold proper conduct.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“You can expect to see the same of..."
entries.dialogueText: “You can expect to see the same of my vice presidency."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“Not just any woman. A strong woman..."
entries.dialogueText: “Not just any woman. A strong woman who was able to protect order in a roomful of unruly men for 7 years."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“Think about the message it would s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Think about the message it would send. The first woman Vice President of Sordland. No. The first woman Vice President in the whole continent!”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“What support you would lose among..."
entries.dialogueText: “What support you would lose among traditionalists, you would gain tenfold among Sordish women.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That will be all for now. Thank yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “That will be all for now. Thank you.”
entries.menuText: “That will be all for now. Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You are right. There is much to ga..."
entries.dialogueText: “You are right. There is much to gain. I will consider it.”
entries.menuText: “You are right. There is much to gain. I will consider it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'd rather not align myself with t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'd rather not align myself with the conservative wing.”
entries.menuText: “I'd rather not align myself with the conservative wing.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“There is much to gain from selecti..."
entries.dialogueText: “There is much to gain from selecting me, Mr. President. I believe you will make the right choice.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“A shame, then. I had hoped you wou..."
entries.dialogueText: “A shame, then. I had hoped you would see the opportunity. I guess you lack the experience to do so.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“I wish you a nice day, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: “I wish you a nice day, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“I knew you would see reason.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I knew you would see reason.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gloria made her way out. A minute l..."
entries.dialogueText: Gloria made her way out. A minute later, there was another knock at the door. This time, it was Albin Clavin's turn.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Greetings, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Greetings, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It certainly is.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It certainly is.”
entries.menuText: “It certainly is.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's talk.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's talk.”
entries.menuText: “Let's talk.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: ""It's a great honor to have been ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a great honor to have been chosen as a candidate. Really terrific."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will be straightforward. Why sho..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will be straightforward. Why should I pick you?”
entries.menuText: “I will be straightforward. Why should I pick you?”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“As you know, I represent the refor..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you know, I represent the reformist wing of the party.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“I hope to satisfy the requirements..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope to satisfy the requirements of this sacred position.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“What Sordland needs today is not o..."
entries.dialogueText: “What Sordland needs today is not only to catch up to our more modern neighbors, but to surpass them.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“I believe we can do that. No. I am..."
entries.dialogueText: “I believe we can do that. No. I am sure!”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“However, this will only be possibl..."
entries.dialogueText: “However, this will only be possible if we set aside our differences and unite as one. That is the outlook I wish to bring to the position of Vice President.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“So that Sordland can excel and soa..."
entries.dialogueText: “So that Sordland can excel and soar to new heights.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very idealistic. I like it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very idealistic. I like it.”
entries.menuText: “Very idealistic. I like it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I did not ask about your opinions...."
entries.dialogueText: “I did not ask about your opinions. What can you provide me with?”
entries.menuText: “I did not ask about your opinions. What can you provide me with?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nonsense. Sordland thrives on trad..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nonsense. Sordland thrives on tradition. Striving for modernity will get us nowhere."
entries.menuText: “Nonsense. Sordland thrives on tradition. Striving for modernity will get us nowhere."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“That is certainly...one opinion, y..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is certainly...one opinion, yes.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“The fact is, if I am the Vice Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: “The fact is, if I am the Vice President, reformist members of our party will be more likely to support you and your causes."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“This will smooth the passage of bi..."
entries.dialogueText: “This will smooth the passage of bills and help move our administration and our country forward in record time.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I agree completely.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I agree completely.”
entries.menuText: “I agree completely.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“*If* you join the administration,..."
entries.dialogueText: “*If* you join the administration, that is. I don't think that's likely."
entries.menuText: “*If* you join the administration, that is. I don't think that's likely."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That makes sense.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That makes sense.”
entries.menuText: “That makes sense.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“As unlikely as it is, we all must..."
entries.dialogueText: “As unlikely as it is, we all must try.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“And now what this country needs is..."
entries.dialogueText: “And now what this country needs is more dynamic, youthful leadership.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Look at you, President Rayne. You..."
entries.dialogueText: “Look at you, President Rayne. You became the youngest member of the Assembly and completely rejuvenated Sordish politics. I want to do the same.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Not that you might have forgotten,..."
entries.dialogueText: “Not that you might have forgotten, but I would also like to remind you that you promised me a position in exchange for my support at the Assembly.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“There. I've stated my case.”"
entries.dialogueText: “There. I've stated my case.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm a man of my word.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm a man of my word.”
entries.menuText: “I'm a man of my word.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Times have changed.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Times have changed.”
entries.menuText: “Times have changed.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We will see about it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We will see about it.”
entries.menuText: “We will see about it.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“I always took you for a man of hon..."
entries.dialogueText: “I always took you for a man of honor.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“We need to be able to take risks t..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to be able to take risks to make gains and that is only possible with a forward-looking perspective."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“A promise once given has to be kep..."
entries.dialogueText: “A promise once given has to be kept, Mr. President. It would be foolish to go back on your word at this point."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“I trust your judgement.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I trust your judgement.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Aligning myself with the reformist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aligning myself with the reformist wing does not seem like the way forward.”
entries.menuText: “Aligning myself with the reformist wing does not seem like the way forward.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you. I will consider what yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you. I will consider what you said."
entries.menuText: “Thank you. I will consider what you said."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This will be all for now. Thank yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “This will be all for now. Thank you.”
entries.menuText: “This will be all for now. Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“You're quite wrong there -- opposi..."
entries.dialogueText: “You're quite wrong there -- opposing our views will send Sordland backwards. I thought you would understand."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Thank you, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Albin got up and left."
entries.dialogueText: Albin got up and left.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I leaned back in my chair, thinking..."
entries.dialogueText: I leaned back in my chair, thinking about the pros and cons of each of my vice presidential candidates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Replacing Livia had been easy. But..."
entries.dialogueText: Replacing Livia had been easy. But replacing my Vice President would be difficult.
